blockHints.station_name: Short title for the portfolio station (e.g. 'Portfolio – Tell me about yourself and professional knowledge')
blockHints.station_type: Type of ortho station (clinical, communication, prioritisation, portfolio)
blockHints.clinical_scenario: Brief instructions for the candidate and examiner. Describe the two-part portfolio station (Part 1: CAMP, person specifications; Part 2: audit/QIP/research, NJR, GIRFT, BPT, reflection). State that the station is personalised to the candidate's CV and that questions will draw on their experience, education, and CV.
blockHints.duration_minutes: Total duration in minutes (typically 10 = 5 min × 2 parts)
blockHints.portfolio_themes: Themes covered in the station. Examples: 'CAMP', 'Person specifications', 'Audit vs QIP vs research', 'NJR, GIRFT, best practice tariff', 'Reflection and never events', 'Personalised CV-based questions'
blockHints.interview_questions: Q&A pairs. MUST include: (1) Personalised questions drawn from the candidate's experience, education, research, audits, teaching, leadership, or achievements; (2) Standard portfolio questions: Why should we choose you? Person specifications? Why orthopaedics? Audit/QIP/research and differences? Standard vs guideline? NJR? GIRFT? Best practice tariff? Complaints procedure? An error you have made? What is a never event?
blockHints.key_learning_points: Summary of what the candidate should demonstrate. Examples: 'Articulate experience and person spec alignment', 'Explain NJR, GIRFT, BPT', 'Reflect on error and never events', 'Use CV evidence to justify registrar appointment'
blockHints.references: Relevant guidance. Examples: 'Person specification for ST3 Orthopaedics', 'GMC Good Medical Practice', 'NJR', 'GIRFT', 'NHS Never Events list'
blockHints.approved: Whether this station has been approved for use
